claim: Blood's monuments are stepped bases of raised sectors under open sky: tools/mine_monuments.py over the campaign, Bloodbath and curated community maps found 421 in 66 maps (monuments-v1.json; 431 in 63 maps when rerun on 2026-11-26), two tiers in 389 and three in 30, a tier rising a median 0.42 bodies, the base 2.0 plan units and the top a third of it (0.62). Only 77 carry anything: most often a sector sound marker (type 709 on tile 2520, 23), then candles (938), glows (624), flames (2101), a few stone face ornaments (634) and boulders (805). No figure sprite is among the tiles found on a top tier.
